title: Guidepoint Relocates Shanghai Office to the Bund Center
summary: Guidepoint is moving its Shanghai office to the Bund Center on East Yan'an Road, following more than a decade of growth in China. The office will house research, product innovation, compliance, and operations capabilities. Michael Wang, Director and Head of China, and Chris Bonsi, Head of APAC, said the move reinforces the firm's long-term commitment to the region.
whyItMatters: Guidepoint continues to invest in an on-the-ground China presence at a time when expert-network operations in the country remain under close compliance scrutiny.
